# ============================================================
# CHARACTER PAGE TEMPLATE
# 1. Copy this file to docs/characters/<character-slug>.md
# 2. Fill in the `author:` block below (it becomes the sidebar card)
# 3. Add the page to docs/_data/navigation.yml
#
# `avatar` and `home` get your site's baseurl added automatically.
# Internal urls inside `links` do NOT, so write them in full,
# e.g. /echoes-of-the-soul/lore/
# Icons: any Font Awesome name, e.g. "fas fa-users", "fas fa-gem", "fas fa-skull"
# ============================================================
title: "Character Name"
author_profile: true          # shows the profile card in the sidebar
author:
  name: "Character Name"
  avatar: /assets/images/characters/character-slug.jpg   # square image, about 400x400
  bio: "Epithet or one-line tagline. *Markdown works here.*"
  location: "Home city or region"
  home: /characters/character-slug.html                  # where the name links to
  links:
    - label: "Rank 1 Runebearer"
      icon: "fas fa-gem"
      url: /echoes-of-the-soul/core-concepts/rank-and-fusion.html
    - label: "Faction: Name"
      icon: "fas fa-users"
      url: /echoes-of-the-soul/lore/
    - label: "All characters"
      icon: "fas fa-address-book"
      url: /echoes-of-the-soul/characters/
header:
  overlay_image: /assets/images/splash.svg
  overlay_filter: 0.5
---
